temas.concepto: Cuando le diste tanto a algo que irte se siente como tirarte vos mismo a la basura — y te quedás, no por amor, sino porque no bancás soltar la cuenta.
temas.voz: Voz masculina, grave y susurrada en los versos, cruda y abierta en el estribillo, casi hablada en el bridge
temas.caption: Dark pop, pitched 808 bass, sparse detuned piano, vinyl crackle, slow trap hi-hats, ambient pads, melancholic, introspective, 82 BPM. Male voice, low breathy verses, raw open chorus, half-whispered bridge.
temas.letra:
[intro]
Mm-mm... mm-mm...

[verse]
Moved my books across the bridge, January rain
Taped the boxes with both names — your writing, then my strain
I learned to sleep along the left, I learned to like the cold
Knew your coffee order by the time I was nineteen years old
The savings bled through March and I didn't say a word
I pawned the chain my mother left — you never even heard
Six years of rent in someone else's town, someone else's street
I put down roots in borrowed ground before I felt the heat

[pre-chorus]
And now you're asking why I stay
As if the door still opens the same way

[chorus]
Too far in to find the door
Too far in to know who I was before
Every box I moved still pins me to this floor
I'm too far in — what was it for?

[verse]
The lease came up in autumn, felt it tighten in my chest
A slant of light across the room — I turned and faced the rest
Your jacket on the kitchen chair like it had always hung
The coffee pot still set for two, the morning barely strung
I typed a one-way ticket in the browser late at night
The price so low it mocked me, every digit burning bright
I closed the tab and washed the cups and ironed all your shirts
I've stitched myself into this seam too tight to feel it hurts

[pre-chorus]
And still you're asking why I stay
As if I'd recognize myself away

[chorus]
Too far in to find the door
Too far in to know who I was before
Every box I moved still pins me to this floor
I'm too far in — what was it for?

[bridge]
What if this was never love — just math I couldn't undo?
A ledger full of everything I ever gave to you
The penny jar so full by now it cannot leave the shelf
I'd have to break the glass to go — the shards would take what's left

[chorus]
Too far in to find the door
Too far in to know who I was before
I could lift the boxes, I could leave this floor
But I'm too far in — I always need one more

[outro]
One more... one more...

temas.concepto: Estás enganchada a alguien que te da todo una noche y desaparece la siguiente, y cada vez que vuelve el alivio se siente igual que amor.
temas.voz: dúo: ella abre aireada y etérea, él entra cálido e íntimo en tenor medio, armonías entrelazadas en el estribillo
temas.captionInstrumental: Dark synth-pop, pulsing arpeggiated analog synths, 80s drum machine, deep sub-bass, shimmering reverb pads, cinematic tension, hypnotic, restless, building dynamics, 108 BPM, F# minor.
temas.captionVoces: Male and female duet. She opens: airy ethereal mid-range. He enters: warm intimate tenor. Layered harmonies in chorus, call-and-response verses.
temas.beat: The call transforms into a mirrored reflection during the bridge, symbolizing the cyclical nature of this intermittent reinforcement.

historia.quien: The narrator is a young architect working late nights in a nearly empty, modern office building in downtown São Paulo. They've become fixated on the building’s automated lighting system – specifically, a single, powerful spotlight that occasionally illuminates a specific, beautiful corner of the city skyline.
historia.verso1: It's 3:17 AM. The narrator is hunched over blueprints, exhaustion blurring the lines, when the spotlight suddenly flickers to life, bathing the skyline in an intense, beautiful glow. They’ve been anticipating this moment, and the brief, radiant view feels like a reward for their dedication and loneliness.
historia.estribillo: The chorus expresses the addictive cycle of anticipation and fleeting satisfaction the narrator experiences from the spotlight's return. It's a feeling of almost-love, a desperate relief coupled with knowing the light will inevitably vanish again – a phantom promise.
historia.verso2: Days turn into weeks, and the narrator starts manipulating the building's system, subtly at first, then with increasing boldness. They discover how to prolong the light's duration, dim it, and even redirect it, but the manipulations bring a hollowness and a growing sense of dependence on this impersonal source of validation.
historia.puente: The narrator realizes the 'love' isn't for the light itself, but for the *power* it gives them – the control, the brief illusion of influence over something vast and indifferent. They decide to actively try and *break* the cycle, by sabotaging the spotlight, risking the loss of the feeling entirely.

temas.concepto: Llorar a alguien que todavía está al lado tuyo, velando en silencio una versión que ya murió mientras la persona sigue respirando.
temas.rasgo: Duelo por algo que sigue vivo
temas.voz: dúo: ella abre etérea y aireada, él entra grave y cálido, armonías en capas en el estribillo
temas.captionInstrumental: Dark cinematic alt-R&B, layered reverbed electric guitars, shoegaze textures, deep sub-bass, ethereal pad swells, tight electronic drums, mournful yet urgent, building dynamics, 120 BPM, C minor.
temas.captionVoces: Female and male duet; she opens airy ethereal mid-range, he enters low and warm, layered harmonies in chorus, intimate whispered bridge.
temas.beat: The call, initially a mournful climb, in the bridge momentarily slows and mirrors itself, highlighting the trapped nature of grief alongside a living presence.

historia.quien: The narrator is a botanist, Elias, working late in a research greenhouse, meticulously caring for a rare, genetically modified orchid known as 'Aetheria.' He's mourning the original, wild version of the orchid, now extinct, while tending to its altered descendant.
historia.verso1: Elias is meticulously adjusting the humidity levels around Aetheria, using specialized equipment. He remembers the day the original Aetheria, vibrant and untamed, was declared extinct due to a blight, and the immense pressure to recreate it through genetic engineering.
historia.estribillo: He's grieving a lost wildness, a version of the orchid that no longer exists, while continuing to nurture its sterile, engineered replacement; it's a mourning *for* something that 'lives' on in a diminished form.
historia.verso2: A young intern, Chloe, enters the greenhouse, complimenting Elias’s dedication but subtly questioning the point of clinging to the past, suggesting he should focus on the potential of Aetheria's modified traits for wider applications. Elias defensively shuts down the conversation, doubling his efforts to maintain the last vestiges of the original's environment.
historia.puente: Looking at Aetheria, Elias realizes he isn't mourning the *orchid* itself, but the potential for true, unburdened natural growth and discovery that its extinction represents; he decides to start a clandestine project to recreate a natural habitat outside the lab, even if it’s just a small corner, to give *something* a chance to truly bloom.

temas.concepto: Un amor obsesivo a una ciudad, una trampa de luces y promesas rotas, donde la belleza esconde la decadencia y el alma se consume en la búsqueda de algo inalcanzable.
temas.voz: dúo: él con voz profunda y melodías quebradas, ella con susurros etéreos y reverberación extensa
temas.captionInstrumental: dark trap, melodic trap, gliding 808 bass, crisp trap hi-hats with triplets, detuned bells, layered ambient textures, spacious production, cinematic atmosphere.
temas.captionVoces: Male rapper: brooding, textured flow, introspective delivery. Female voice: breathy, ethereal, layered harmonies, haunting melodies.
temas.beat: The call transforms into a distorted echo, reflecting the protagonist's fractured perception of the city's promises.

historia.quien: The narrator is a disillusioned architectural photographer in his late 20s, living in Neo-Veridia, a futuristic, over-developed metropolis, ten years after its construction boom. He’s been chasing the 'perfect' image of the city for years, believing it holds a key to understanding something profound, but is increasingly hollowed out by the pursuit.
historia.verso1: The song opens with the photographer observing Neo-Veridia at dusk from his apartment window - a panoramic view of gleaming towers piercing the smog. He meticulously adjusts his camera settings, obsessively framing the city’s skyline, seeking that one, elusive shot that captures its 'soul,' ignoring the growing emptiness he feels.
historia.estribillo: The chorus expresses a desperate, consuming love for Neo-Veridia – recognizing its beauty as a dangerous illusion, a 'static bloom' of manufactured perfection masking a decaying core. It's a city that promises everything but delivers only emptiness and the slow erosion of self.
historia.verso2: He ventures out into the city, documenting the cracks appearing in the polished facade: a crumbling plaza, a boarded-up theatre, the weary faces of maintenance workers. He captures these details, initially seeing them as flaws, but slowly recognizing they represent a truth the city's architects and promoters actively suppress.
historia.puente: While reviewing his photos, the photographer realizes that his pursuit of Neo-Veridia’s ‘soul’ was a rationalization - a way to avoid confronting his own stagnation and the failure of his dreams. He decides to stop photographing the city and instead, focuses on documenting the people struggling within its shadows, seeking a different kind of truth.

temas.concepto: Se aferra a la nostalgia de una ciudad que nunca existió, una promesa de pertenencia que solo se encuentra en la memoria y la adicción.
temas.voz: dúo: él, voz grave con flow entrecortado; ella, susurros angelicales y resonantes
temas.captionInstrumental: dark trap, cinematic trap, gliding 808 bass, crisp trap hi-hats with triplets, haunting bells, granular textures, spacious reverb, melancholic pads, slow tempo.
temas.captionVoces: Male rapper: deep, textured voice, double-time flow. Female voice: breathy, ethereal, layered harmonies, haunting ad-libs.
temas.beat: The call transforms into a backwards echo during the bridge, symbolizing the distorted memories of a lost place.

historia.quien: The narrator is a young man, mid-twenties, living in a rapidly gentrifying industrial district of Buenos Aires, Argentina, circa 2010. He's a former street artist, now working a dead-end job in a warehouse, feeling disconnected and haunted by the city’s fading working-class identity.
historia.verso1: The verse opens with the narrator standing on a crumbling concrete platform overlooking a former factory complex, now slated for luxury apartments. He's tracing faded murals on the walls – remnants of his past and the community that once thrived there; he remembers painting them with friends, fueled by cheap beer and a sense of rebellious belonging.
historia.estribillo: The chorus expresses a longing for a Buenos Aires that never truly existed – a time of gritty authenticity, shared struggle, and artistic freedom, now lost to progress and commercialization; it's a yearning for a feeling of belonging rooted in a collective past, laced with the bittersweet taste of addiction to that memory.
historia.verso2: The narrator is approached by a developer who recognizes his artwork and offers him a commission to create a 'heritage mural' for the new apartment complex.  He initially resists, feeling it's a betrayal of his ideals, but the promise of money and a renewed sense of purpose (however hollow) lures him in.
historia.puente: While painting the mural, the narrator notices a young girl sketching nearby, mirroring his own youthful passion. He realizes the 'ghosts' he's chasing aren't just about the past, but about the potential for creation and connection that exists *now*, and that clinging solely to nostalgia prevents him from shaping a new future.

temas.concepto: Cuando se apagan los reflectores y se prenden las luces de la sala, él se queda solo frente al escenario vacío y no se banca volver a ser uno más, así que vive esperando la próxima función aunque el escenario le esté comiendo la vida.
temas.rasgo: miedo a ser común sin eso
temas.voz: dúo: ella abre sola en falsete lejano, él rapea filoso y con actitud, ella vuelve etérea en el estribillo y el cierre
temas.captionInstrumental: cinematic trap, half-time drums, clap on beat three, hard sliding 808 bass, rapid hi-hat rolls and triplets, staccato dark strings, haunting low choir, ominous brass stabs, sparse, menacing, wide reverb, tense silence, 140 BPM, B minor
temas.captionVoces: male rapper leads, gritty mid-low timbre, confident syncopated flow, aggressive cadence; female voice only on intro, hook and outro, airy haunting falsetto, distant, reverbed
temas.beat: el zumbido de las luces de la sala (armónicos de B2 con flicker de 60 Hz).
